assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness in the setting of known paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and atherosclerotic heart disease.
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias and to assess the efficacy of current rate control management.
The patient has paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0).
The patient has atherosclerotic heart disease (I25.10).
Mobile cardiac telemetry is coded as CPT 93229.
The payer's denial is under Reason Code PR-204.
The payer denied the claim for Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229).
Reason Code PR-204 indicates that the service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan.
Coverage limitations are defined by the contracted policy terms and the procedure falls outside those parameters.
The payer directs the claimant to review the Explanation of Benefits for detailed coverage guidelines.
The claimant has the right to file an appeal if they disagree with the determination.
Appeals must be submitted in writing within ninety days of the notice.
The appeal should include all supporting clinical documentation and a detailed letter of medical necessity.
The denial contradicts the clinical indication and the clinical indication supports the medical necessity of the service.
